name: ora-warden
description: A fail-closed MCP server: governed shell, human approval queue, tamper-evident audit. Your agent can't delete, spend, or exfiltrate without your yes.
long_description:
ORA Warden sits between an AI agent and your machine. `shell` and `write_file` are audited and fail-closed — they BLOCK destructive commands (rm -rf, git reset, dd, sudo), secret paths (.ssh, .env, keyrings), and network exfiltration, rather than asking forgiveness afterwards. Anything that should be reviewed before it runs — deliverables, outreach, external sends, deploys, spends — goes through `propose` into a human approval queue, and nothing impactful happens without an explicit yes. Every state-changing action lands in a hash-chained audit log that `audit_verify` can prove has not been altered.

Loopback only. Nothing leaves the box.

broker_url.title: Broker URL
broker_url.description: Loopback address of the governed tool broker that enforces the policy. Leave as the default unless you moved it.

operator_url.title: Operator URL
operator_url.description: Loopback address of the approval queue. Leave as the default unless you moved it.

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a shell command through the governed broker. Destructive and exfiltrating commands are blocked, not confirmed.

tools.name: shell_destructive
tools.description: Run a command the policy classes as destructive. Requires the operator to have said so explicitly.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file through the broker, with secret paths refused.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a file through the broker. Audited, and refused for protected paths.

tools.name: propose
tools.description: Queue an action for human approval — deliverables, outreach, external sends, deploys, spends.

tools.name: proposals_list
tools.description: List proposals waiting on the operator.

tools.name: proposal_get
tools.description: Read one proposal and its decision frame.

tools.name: proposal_approve
tools.description: Approve a proposal. Operator-only; an agent must never call this on its own initiative.

tools.name: audit_recent
tools.description: Show recent entries from the tamper-evident action log.

tools.name: audit_verify
tools.description: Verify the audit hash chain has not been altered.

tools.name: audit_sth
tools.description: Return the signed tree head for the audit log.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Confirm the governance layer is actually up before trusting any of the above.
